title: Week 2 College Football Predictions from the T Shoe Index
completenessNotes: Full public article was available and exhausted. It contains two explicit early Week 2 betting constructions and their stated mechanisms/prices. No additional wager, score prediction, first-half angle, or total was inferred.

recordsExtracted.summary: Shoemaker explicitly bets Penn State -23.5 and says he would play it to -24. He cites Penn State's Week 1 speed on defense, efficient passing offense (6.8 yards per play and 12 yards per pass attempt), and a dominant defensive showing against Marshall; TSI makes Penn State -31 and his market-estimated formula -26.5, so he believes the market may need several games to catch up.

recordsExtracted.summary: Shoemaker explicitly bets Ohio moneyline at -130 or better. His mechanism is that Ohio was competitive with Nebraska for three quarters before Big Ten depth separated the game, while Jacksonville State was outplayed by FBS newcomer North Dakota State, producing only 2.7 yards per carry, 3.7 yards per pass attempt and a 28% success rate. TSI's spread projection is near market, but his on-field grades favor Ohio by six.
